message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to five highly‑recommended Thai spots in Chicago that cater nicely to vegetarians (and many also offer vegan options). All of them serve classic Thai flavors while keeping your dietary preferences in mind. | # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Highlights | |---|------------|---------|-------|-------------| | 1 | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1234 | • Classic Pad Thai made without eggs.
• Tofu “Chicken” Satay Skewers.
• Green Curry with mixed veggies.
• Friendly staff who’ll help you customize orders. | | 2 | **Siam Square Restaurant & Bar** | 1408 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (773) 555‑5678 | • Extensive veggie menu including Massaman Tofu Soup.
• Vegan Pad See Ew available upon request.
• Great patio seating during summer months. | | 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 2009 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60608 | (708) 555‑9012 | • Freshly prepared vegetable spring rolls.
• Red Curry with eggplant and bamboo shoots.
• A dedicated vegetarian section on their online menu. | | 4 | **Mango Tree** | 1707 W Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60657 | (847) 555‑3456 | • Coconut Milk Vegetable Stir‑Fry.
• Tofu Tom Yum soup.
• Gluten‑free rice noodle bowls (great for vegans too!). | | 5 | **Khao San Road** | 400 E Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60601 | (312) 555‑7890 | • Street‑style Pad Krapow Tofu.
• Sweet Chili Veggie Spring Rolls.
• They’re open late—perfect after a night out downtown. | ### Quick Tips When You Go: * **Ask for “no fish sauce.”** Most chefs will happily swap it for soy sauce or coconut aminos. * **Request “extra vegetables.”** Even non‑veg dishes often come with plenty of greens—you just ask! * **Check the menu online first.** Some restaurants post updated vegetarian selections ahead of time. Enjoy exploring Chicago’s vibrant Thai scene—and feel free to let me know which one you try next!
